user_supplied_material.purpose: Evaluate external-AI material supplied for critique against the Operator's actual source-linked mission and decisions. Never guess authorship from length, typo rate, fluency, formatting or meandering.
user_supplied_material.repair: Attribute each source span; compare proposal against actual operator decisions, existing capability and evidence; test hidden harms; apply only explicitly adopted scoped gains; repair verified safe defects through owning provider; preserve provenance and continue.
